title: AT2026zwn · ATLAS difference photometry
caption: AT2026zwn: all 35 retained ATLAS o-band forced difference-flux measurements, 25 July–26 August 2026 UTC. Error bars are the original reported flux_error values; no confidence level is assigned here. Filled gold points have detection=1 (11 rows), and hollow teal points have detection=0 (24 rows). All 10 negative values and 24 low-SNR rows remain. Every row carries southern-template-discontinuity-caution; no template correction or fitted light curve is applied. These plotted values alone do not establish an explosion time or physical classification.

provenance.verification_scope: Exact parity with the pinned public CTAS artifact; provider measurements were not independently re-retrieved.

selection.rule: Every follow_up.observations row for AT2026zwn; chronological order; no quality cuts, binning, offsets or fitted model.

uncertainty_convention: Original source flux_error values. No sigma level or confidence coverage is asserted beyond the retained source metadata.
caveats: Difference flux is retained, including negative values and measurements with detection=0.
No explosion time, baseline correction, physical classification or fitted transient model is inferred.
